title: Contracts Administrator
salary_text: £28000 - £30000 per year (Hybrid working, progression and more)
description:
Contracts Administrator

Hemel Hempstead - Hybrid

Temporary - Hourly equivalent of 28,000 - 30,000

Immediate Start!

We're delighted to be recruiting for a world-renowned international business that provide essential products and services across its sector. With a fantastic reputation and a head office based in Hemel Hempstead, this is a brilliant opportunity to join a successful, forward-thinking organisation with modern, stylish offices and a genuinely great working environment.

We're looking for a Contracts Administrator to join the team on a temporary basis, with an immediate start available.

We are looking for someone that is able to commit to staying until the end of 2027. If agreed, this could mean around 16 months of work, making this a very attractive opportunity for someone looking for stability for a long period of time with great opportunities for something longer term down the line too.

What will you be doing?

This is a varied administrative role where you'll support the team across contracts, quotations, tenders and customer queries. You'll be working with internal teams and customers, keeping information accurate and making sure things move forward efficiently.

Day-to-day, you can expect to:
- Enter, maintain and manage tender, contract and quotation data across ERP and CRM systems.
- Prepare and create quotes and contracts for defined product areas, working within agreed approvals and policies.
- Act as a point of contact for contractual queries and proactively work towards resolving customer requests.
- Deal with pricing queries and liaise with relevant teams to find solutions.
- Complete a range of administrative tasks relating to tenders, contracts and quotations.
- Keep information accurate and up to date while managing a varied workload and competing priorities.

What are we looking for?

We're looking for someone who is energetic, organised and comfortable working at pace. You don't necessarily need to have worked in exactly the same role before - what's most important is that you're confident working with systems, enjoy learning and aren't afraid to ask questions.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a back-office, administration, contracts, quotations, tenders, sales support or similar environment.
- Experience using an ERP or CRM system. SAP experience would be a huge advantage, but it is not essential - experience with another system is absolutely fine if you're confident picking up new software quickly.
- A naturally curious and inquisitive approach - someone who asks questions, wants to understand how things work and isn't afraid to get stuck in.
- The ability to work at pace and manage a busy workload without losing attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong organisation skills with a reliable and proactive approach.
- The ability to take initiative, identify problems and look for solutions.
- A flexible attitude and willingness to learn and adapt.

SAP or Salesforce experience would be a fantastic bonus, but neither is essential. If you've used another CRM, ERP or business system and can demonstrate that you're a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you.

Working hours & benefits
- Monday to Friday, full-time hours
- Hybrid working: 3 days in the Hemel Hempstead office and 2 days working remotely
- Modern offices based in the Maylands area of Hemel Hempstead
- Free on-site parking
- Weekly pay + holiday accrual
- 28,000- 30,000 salary equivalent, depending on experience
- Immediate start available
- A good and lengthy assignment to the end of 2027

Please ensure the Maylands area of Hemel Hempstead is a realistic commute for you before applying.

Interested?

If you're looking for a role where you can get stuck in, learn quickly, work with a well-known international business and potentially secure long-term temporary work through to the end of 2027, we'd love to hear from you.

Looking for your next opportunity? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead, working across Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire and Buckinghamshire. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment across administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales administration/sales support, marketing and IT Helpdesk/IT support.

title: Customer service advisor
description:
Location: Hemel Hempstead Pay: 12.71 per hour + holiday pay Hours: Monday to Friday, shifts between 9:00am and 6:30pm Start Date: 19th October 2026 Contract: Temp to Perm

Are you looking for temp work in Hemel Hempstead and available to start from 19th October 2026?

we're looking for three customer service professionals to support Customer Service Advisor project with a fantastic and well-established client of ours.

They're well known within the local community for their great team environment, supportive atmosphere and excellent training. We've placed numerous people with them on temporary projects over the years, and for many it has been a great opportunity to gain office-based experience, whilst for others it's simply been a good way to keep busy and earn some extra money.

In this role, you'd typically be taking inbound calls, processing payments and dealing with customer queries, following a straightforward and largely scripted processes. Full training will be provided on how to structure these calls and use their phone and computer system too.

The company is PCI compliant, so you won't have any exposure to customers' card information.

As part of this role, you'd be working during core hours, Monday to Friday, with shifts such as:

9am to 5pm / 9.30am to 5.30pm / 10am to 6pm / 10.30am to 6.30pm

This is an office-based role in the Apsley area of Hemel Hempstead, and remote working isn't an option. With this in mind, you'll need to be able to get to the office each day.

Please be aware mobile phones aren't permitted within the Contact Centre and would need to be stored in a designated locker during working hours. This is worth bearing in mind when considering the role.

We're initially looking for people who are available for a few weeks of work, although there will likely be opportunities for some people to continue with the company on a longer-term basis too.

The role will be weekly paid whilst temping, paying 12.71 per hour + holiday pay accrual.

Due to the industry of this company, you'll also be required to undergo a credit check and DBS check. These will be arranged and paid for by an outsourced service provider if you're successfully offered the role, and you'll just need to complete some forms and provide proof of ID and address.

We're ideally looking to book short telephone chats/interviews, followed by a few days to a week for the necessary compliance checks. This means we're hoping to have people starting from 19th October 2026.

title: Office and Accounts Administrator
description:
My client is a highly successful, family-run electrical contracting business based in Hemel Hempstead. As part of their continued expansion, they are looking to recruit an experienced Office Administrator who enjoys working as part of a close-knit team and takes pride in helping a business run smoothly.

This is a newly created role within the business and offers an exciting opportunity to become an integral part of a growing company. You will work closely with the Managing Director, Project Manager, Project Teams and Accounts, providing essential administrative support across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:
- Managing the company s emails and responding to customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner
- Answering and directing incoming telephone calls
- Creating and maintaining project templates using Simpro (training will be given)
- Raising and processing invoices using Xero
- Providing general administrative support to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the business
- Assisting with office facilities, including purchasing equipment, stationery and consumables when required
- Providing administrative and organisational support to the Managing Director
- Organising company events and supporting the charities and community initiatives that the company is involved with
- Working collaboratively with the wider team to ensure projects and administrative processes run efficiently
- Using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, alongside Xero and Simpro

About You

The successful candidate will be an experienced administrator, ideally with at least 5 years experience in an office administration, coordination or similar role.

You will be someone who:
- Enjoys working as part of a team
- Is highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities
- Has excellent attention to detail
- Is confident communicating with customers and colleagues at all levels
- Takes a proactive approach and is happy to get involved wherever needed
- Is confident using Microsoft Office
- Has experience with Xero and/or Simpro (although training may be provided for the right candidate)
- Wants to be part of a growing business where their contribution will genuinely make a difference

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to join a genuinely friendly, supportive and successful family-run business with an ambitious future. As this is a newly created position, there is plenty of scope for the successful candidate to make the role their own and become an important part of the company's continued growth.

If you live within an easy commuting distance of Hemel Hempstead, Herts, have the relevant experience and feel this could be the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply now with your CV and a covering letter explaining why you feel this is the role for you.

Immediate start available.

title: Part-time Accounts Receivable Administrator
description:

With a new ERP system currently being implemented, the finance team is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Administrator to join them on a temporary, part-time basis for approximately 6 months.

This role will be for 20 hours a week across 5 days (mornings) with the option to work from home 2 days a week.

This is a hands on role where you will make an immediate difference, taking pressure off the AR team and ensuring day-to-day processes continue without disruption.

This is a fantastic opportunity to step into a global business during a busy period, work closely with multiple finance teams, and be part of a supportive, collaborative environment. The company prides itself on its values, and they're looking for someone who will reflect these in the way they work every day.

If you're ready to commit to this project and provide vital support through a key transition, we'd love to hear from you.

Duties to include:
- Allocate customer payments - match money received to the correct customer/invoices.
- Deal with BACS/direct debit receipts and make sure everything is posted correctly.
- Investigate unallocated cash

Candidate Requirements:
- Previous experience within Accounts Receivable, Sales Ledger or Cash Allocation
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Good Excel skills, including spreadsheets and reporting
- Ability to manage high transaction volumes and meet deadlines
- Organised and methodical approach to work
- Strong communication skills
- Proactive problem solver
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

If you're ready to commit to this project and provide vital support through a key transition, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Purchasing Administrator
description:
We are seeking a Purchasing Administrator to work for a manufacturer of scientific machinery based in Hemel Hempstead.

The purchasing Administrator performs the essential function of monitoring the stock of selected items and ordering and processing of Spares Orders. While liasing with suppliers. The individual will work with engineering and general staff to update and maintain prices for spares and parts. The individual must be flexible, hard-working, the ability to communicate effectively with people on all levels in a friendly and professional manner, show initiative in improving our current systems. Training will be provided.

Key Responsibilities:
- Purcachase goods, materials, components or service in line with specified cost.
- Processing of Spares Orders
- Act as interface between suppliers.
- Monitor and advise on any issues which arise.
- Prepare and raise purchase orders and order schedules
- Build, maintain and manage supplier relationships and keep up good communications.
- Contact suppliers to resolve price, quality, delivery or invoice issues.
- Maintenance of accurate stock levels and control.
- Inspection of goods received.

Essential skills and experience
- Competent in the use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) email and use of the Internet
- Strong administrative skills and well organized
- Proven ability of effective written and verbal communication and listening skills
- Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to effectively communicate
- Commitment to quality
- Ability to work independently or as part of a small team.
- Positive approach to change
- Effective Time Management
- Customer focus

title: Service Coordinator (Field Operarions)
description:
Service Coordinator (Field Operations)

Location: Hemel Hempstead
Salary: 28,000 per annum
Hours: 8:30am - 5:30pm, Monday to Friday
Working Pattern: Hybrid
Contract: Temp to Perm

About the Company

We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established and rapidly growing business that operates a nationwide network of technical equipment and services.

Due to continued growth, they are looking for a proactive and organised Service Coordinator to join their busy operations team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys problem solving, coordinating engineers, working in a fast-paced environment and providing excellent customer service. The role is offered on a temp-to-perm basis, providing the opportunity to secure a permanent position within a growing and supportive business.

The Role

Working as part of a busy operations team, you will be responsible for coordinating field engineers, managing service requests and ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels.

You'll work closely with engineers, contractors and internal departments to ensure issues are resolved efficiently, whilst keeping accurate records and providing regular updates throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinating field engineers across the UK
- Raising, updating and prioritising service tickets
- Scheduling work and allocating jobs to the appropriate engineers
- Liaising with third-party contractors and service providers
- Monitoring service requests and ensuring SLA targets are achieved
- Producing and updating daily operational reports
- Responding to enquiries from internal departments
- Maintaining accurate records and system documentation
- Supporting operational planning and service improvements
- Providing administrative support to the wider operations team

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys working in a busy, fast-paced environment and has excellent organisational and communication skills.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a Service Coordinator, Scheduling, Helpdesk, Customer Service or Operations role
- Experience using ticketing or job management systems
- Excellent customer service and communication skills
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to deadlines
- Good Microsoft Office skills
- A proactive approach and willingness to learn

Experience coordinating field engineers, maintenance teams or technical services would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- 28,000 per annum
- Temp-to-perm opportunity
- Hybrid working
- Excellent training and ongoing development
- Supportive team environment
- Long-term career progression
- Stable and growing business
- Varied and fast-paced role where no two days are the same

If you're a highly organised individual who enjoys coordinating people, solving problems and working as part of a busy operations team, we'd love to hear from you.

We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract roles across administration, customer service, HR, accountancy & finance, sales support, marketing and IT support.
